query: WITH source_pages AS (SELECT s.source_page FROM public.source_pages s JOIN public.books b ON b.id=s.book_id WHERE b.title='Jubayer''s GK'), range_1_201 AS (SELECT generate_series(1,201) AS source_page), range_202_453 AS (SELECT generate_series(202,453) AS source_page), range_454_925 AS (SELECT generate_series(454,925) AS source_page) SELECT json_build_object('covered_1_201',(SELECT count(*) FROM source_pages WHERE source_page BETWEEN 1 AND 201),'missing_1_201',(SELECT count(*) FROM range_1_201 e LEFT JOIN source_pages s ON s.source_page=e.source_page WHERE s.source_page IS NULL),'covered_202_453',(SELECT count(*) FROM source_pages WHERE source_page BETWEEN 202 AND 453),'missing_202_453',(SELECT count(*) FROM range_202_453 e LEFT JOIN source_pages s ON s.source_page=e.source_page WHERE s.source_page IS NULL),'covered_454_925',(SELECT count(*) FROM source_pages WHERE source_page BETWEEN 454 AND 925),'missing_454_925',(SELECT count(*) FROM range_454_925 e LEFT JOIN source_pages s ON s.source_page=e.source_page WHERE s.source_page IS NULL)) AS range_coverage LIMIT 1;
